21700.meaning2: how much? to what extent? how many?
21700.construction:
ka > ki + tta + ka
kitta + ka

examples.text: imasmiṃ uposath'agge sannipatitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gaṇanā kittakā bhikkhū honti?
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: kittayissāmi te dhammaṃ, diṭṭhe dhamme anītihaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
attadaṇḍā bhayaṃ jātaṃ, janaṃ passatha medhagaṃ, saṃvegaṃ kittayissāmi, yathā saṃvijitaṃ mayā.

21703.synonym: abhitthavati, ukkaṃsati, ukkaṃseti, thunāti, thomayati, thometi, vaṇṇayati, saṃvaṇṇeti

examples.text: nāgaṃ vo kittayissāmi, na hi āguṃ karoti so, soraccaṃ avihiṃsā ca, pādā nāgassa te duve.
ye sattasārā anīghā nirāsā, paccekam'ev'ajjhagamaṃsu bodhiṃ, tesaṃ visallāna nar'uttamānaṃ, nāmāni me kittayato suṇātha.
yassa kho tvaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, puṇṇassa nāma bhikkhuno mantāṇiputtassa abhiṇhaṃ kittayamāno ahosi, so… yena andhavanaṃ tena pakkanto divāvihārāyā'ti.

21706.meaning1: as if celebrating; as if singing the praises (of)
21706.meaning2: as if celebrating; as if singing the praises of
21706.commentary: (DNa) bhagavantaṃ kittayamānarūpo'ti aho buddho, aho dhammo, aho saṅgho, aho dhammo svākkhāto'ti evaṃ kittayanto'va kālam'akāsi.

examples.text: devā, mahārāja, tāvatiṃsā sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ kittayamānarūpā sannisinnā, lābhā vata, bho, videhānaṃ, suladdhaṃ vata, bho, videhānaṃ, yesaṃ nimi rājā dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā, dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu c'eva jānapadesu ca, uposathañ'ca upavasati cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ aṭṭhamiñ'ca pakkhassā'ti.

so kho panā'pi ahosi buddhe pasanno dhamme pasanno saṅghe pasanno sīlesu paripūrakārī. apissudaṃ manussā evam'āhaṃsu, yāva maraṇakālā'pi rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro bhagavantaṃ kittayamānarūpo kālaṅ'kato'ti.

21707.meaning1: in what way?; to what extent?; in what respect?
21707.construction:
ka > ki + tāva + tā
kittāva + tā

examples.text: suñño loko, suñño loko'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, suñño loko'ti vuccatī'ti?
na hi pana taṃ, gahapati, paṭibhāsi bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ paṭipucchituṃ, kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, āturakāyo c'eva hoti āturacitto ca, kittāvatā ca pana āturakāyo hi kho hoti no ca āturacitto'ti?
yaso kitti ca yā pubbe, hāyate vā'pi tassa sā, etam'pi disvā sikkhetha, methunaṃ vippahātave.
aggasmiṃ dānaṃ dadataṃ, aggaṃ puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati. aggaṃ āyu ca vaṇṇo ca, yaso kitti sukhaṃ balaṃ.

21710.commentary: (APAa) mayā kittito thomito yathā ahosi, evam'eva sabbe devamanussā kappakoṭī'pi kappakoṭisate'pi kittentā pakittayuṃ katheyyun'ti attho.

examples.text: opammaṃ upadassetvā, kittito me mahāmuni, buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ kittetvā, kappaṃ saggamhi mod'ahaṃ.
anupāda-sodhana-porisadhammo, sevitabba-bahudhātu-vibhatti, buddhassa kittināma-cattārīsena, ānāpāno kāyagato upapatti.
taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

21717.commentary: (DNa) kittivaṇṇaharā'ti parisamajjhe kathāya sampattāya ko amhākaṃ sāmikehi sadiso atthi, mayaṃ attano dāsabhāvam'pi na jānāma, tesaṃ sāmikabhāvam'pi na jānāma, evaṃ no anukampantī'ti guṇakathāhārakā. (DNt) kitti eva vaṇṇo kittivaṇṇo, taṃ kittivaṇṇaṃ guṇakathaṃ haranti, taṃ taṃ disaṃ upāharantī'ti kittivaṇṇaharā. tathā tathā kittetabbato hi kitti, guṇo, tesaṃ vaṇṇanaṃ kathanaṃ vaṇṇo. ten'āha guṇakathāhārakā'ti.

examples.text: imehi kho, gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi ayyirakaṃ anukampan'ti, pubbuṭṭhāyino ca honti, pacchā nipātino ca, dinnādāyino ca, sukatakammakarā ca, kittivaṇṇaharā ca.
yas'aggapatto sirimā, kittivaṇṇabhato jino, pūjito sabbalokassa, disā sabbāsu vissuto.

21718.commentary: (DNa) kittivaṇṇaharā'ti parisamajjhe kathāya sampattāya ko amhākaṃ sāmikehi sadiso atthi, mayaṃ attano dāsabhāvam'pi na jānāma, tesaṃ sāmikabhāvam'pi na jānāma, evaṃ no anukampantī'ti guṇakathāhārakā. (DNt) kitti eva vaṇṇo kittivaṇṇo, taṃ kittivaṇṇaṃ guṇakathaṃ haranti, taṃ taṃ disaṃ upāharantīti kittivaṇṇaharā. tathā tathā kittetabbato hi kitti, guṇo, tesaṃ vaṇṇanaṃ kathanaṃ vaṇṇo. ten'āha guṇakathāhārakā'ti.

examples.text: imehi kho, gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi ayyirakaṃ anukampan'ti, pubbuṭṭhāyino ca honti, pacchā nipātino ca, dinnādāyino ca, sukatakammakarā ca, kittivaṇṇaharā ca.
saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, no ce assaddhiyaṃ avatiṭṭhati, yaso ca kittī ca tatv'assa hoti, saggañ'ca so gacchati sarīraṃ vihāyā'ti.

21720.meaning1: praises; speaks highly; sings the praises (of)

examples.text: yato kho tvaṃ, mārisa, taṃ bhagavantaṃ kittesi, hotu no ajja samāgamo'ti.
opammaṃ upadassetvā, kittito me mahāmuni, buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ kittetvā, kappaṃ saggamhi mod'ahaṃ.

21723.meaning2: praised; spoke highly; sang the praises (of)

21725.meaning1: how can I?; in what way can I?; what do you think I?

examples.text: saddho ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu hoti, no ca sīlavā. evaṃ so ten'aṅgena aparipūro hoti. tena taṃ aṅgaṃ paripūretabbaṃ, kin't'āhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ, sīlavā cā'ti!
kin't'āhaṃ kuṭikaṃ brūmi, kiṃ te brūmi kulāvakaṃ, kiṃ te santānakaṃ brūmi, kin't'āhaṃ brūmi bandhanan'ti.

21727.meaning1: how then?; what then?; in what way?
21727.commentary: (VINa) kin'ti… upāyapucchā. (ANa) kin'ti mayan'ti kena nāma upāyena mayaṃ

examples.text: so tesaṃ bhogānaṃ ārakkh'ādhikaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, kin'ti me bhoge n'eva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāy'ādā hareyyun'ti
evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ kin'ti byākareyyāthā'ti?

21728.meaning1: what can I do?; how can I help?
21728.commentary: (SNa) kin'ti karomī'ti kathaṃ karomi? mayhañ'hi paṭipattikathanam'eva bhāro, paṭipattipūraṇaṃ pana kulaputtānaṃ bhāro'ti dasseti.

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tam'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kin'ti karomi!

21729.meaningLit: discourse on what (do you think of me)

21730.commentary: (VINa) kiṃ te adhigatan'ti adhigamapucchā, jhānavimokkh'ādīsu, sot'āpattimagg'ādīsu vā kiṃ tayā adhigatan'ti.

examples.text: samanuggāhīyamāno'ti yaṃ vatthu paṭiññātaṃ hoti tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ samanuggāhīyamāno, kin'te adhigataṃ, kin'ti te adhigataṃ, kadā te adhigataṃ, kattha te adhigataṃ

21731.meaning1: mythical creature with the head of a horse and the body of a man
21731.meaning2: bird with a human head, name of a forest dwelling nation
21731.commentary: (APt) assamukhanarasarīratāya kucchito puriso, kiñci vā puriso, purisasadiso'ti vā kimpuriso. evaṃ kinnaro. turaṅgavadana, assamukh'ādīni'pi kinnarassa nāmāni.

examples.text: āruyha selaṃ bhavanaṃ kinnarānaṃ, olokaya pabbatapādamūlaṃ, atha dakkhasī meghasamānavaṇṇaṃ, nigrodharājaṃ atha sahassapādaṃ.

21732.meaning1: like a mythical creature with soft eyes

examples.text: ahaṃ tava vas'ānugo siyaṃ, yadi viharemase kānan'antare, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattaro, pāṇo kinnarimandalocane.

21734.meaning1: mythical creature with the head of a horse and the body of a woman
21734.notes: see MW kiṃnarī for a detailed description

examples.text: ahaṃ tava vas'ānugo siyaṃ, yadi viharemase kānan'antare, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattaro, pāṇo kinnarimandalocane.
akkhīni ca turiyā'r'iva, kinnariyā'r'iva pabbat'antare, tava me nayanāni dakkhiya, bhiyyo kāmaratī pavaḍḍhati.

21736.commentary: (DNa) candano kāmaseṭṭho ca, kinnighaṇḍu nighaṇḍu cā'ti aparo kinnighaṇḍu nāma. pāḷiyaṃ pana kinnughaṇḍū'ti likhanti.

examples.text: candano kāmaseṭṭho ca, kinnighaṇḍu nighaṇḍu ca, panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali.

21737.meaning1: what?; didn't you?; surely you didn't?

examples.text: apuññaṃ pasavī māro, āsajja naṃ tathāgataṃ, kin'nu maññasi pāpima, na me pāpaṃ vipaccati.

21738.commentary: (DNa) candano kāmaseṭṭho ca, kinnighaṇḍu nighaṇḍu cā'ti aparo kinnighaṇḍu nāma. pāḷiyaṃ pana kinnughaṇḍū'ti likhanti. nighaṇḍu cā'ti añño nighaṇḍu nāma, ettakā dāsā.

examples.text: candano kāmaseṭṭho ca, kinnughaṇḍu nighaṇḍu ca, panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali.

21739.commentary: (VINt) kin'nu'mā'va samaṇiyo'ti kiṃ nu imā eva samaṇiyo.

21741.meaning1: ant; termite; (comm) red, black or brown ant
21741.commentary: (VINa) kipillikānan'ti ratta-kāḷa-piṅgal'ādi-bhedānaṃ yāsaṃ kāsañci kipillikānaṃ. kipīllakānan'ti'pi pāṭho. (JAa) kipillikānī'ti upacikāyo.

examples.text: tato kīṭe paṭaṅge ca, yāva kunthakipillike, liṅgaṃ jātimayaṃ tesaṃ, aññam'aññā hi jātiyo.

atha te, jarasakko amhe matte katvā mahāsamuddapiṭṭhe khipitvā amhākaṃ devanagaraṃ gaṇhi, te mayaṃ tena saddhiṃ yujjhitvā amhākaṃ devanagaram'eva gaṇhissāmā'ti kipillikā viya thambhaṃ sineruṃ anusañcaramānā uṭṭhahiṃsu.

21742.meaning1: ant; termite; (comm) red, black or brown ant

examples.text: sārambhaṃ nāma kipillikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, upacikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, undurānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, ahīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, vicchikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, satapadīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, hatthīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti
tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rog'ātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti, akataṃ vata me kalyāṇaṃ, akataṃ kusalaṃ, akataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ, kataṃ pāpaṃ, kataṃ luddaṃ, kataṃ kibbisaṃ.
kiṃ sundarikā karissati, kiṃ payāgo kiṃ bāhukā nadī, veriṃ katakibbisaṃ naraṃ, na hi naṃ sodhaye pāpakamminaṃ.
rajam'ākirasī ahitāya, sante garahasi kibbisakārī, bahūni duccaritāni caritvā, gacchasi kho papataṃ cirarattaṃ.

21745.meaning1: committing crimes; engaging in criminal activities; doing misdeeds

examples.text: te bhūnahuno paccanti, macchā bilakatā yathā, saṃvacchare asaṅkheyye, narā kibbisakārino.

21746.commentary: (SNa) na hi nūna kibbisī'ti evarūpo satthā kibbisakārako nāma na hoti.

examples.text: jegucchī nipako bhikkhu, cātuyāmasusaṃvuto, diṭṭhaṃ sutañ'ca ācikkhaṃ, na hi nūna kibbisī siyā'ti.

21748.meaning1: saying what?; preaching what?; teaching what?

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho daṇḍapāṇi sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kiṃvādī samaṇo kim'akkhāyī'ti?
idha no, āvuso sāriputta, bhagavā kiṃvādī kim'akkhāyī, kathaṃ byākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino c'eva bhagavato assāma, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma

21749.meaning1: how much more so?; how much rather?; what to say of?; why not?

examples.text: tadā'pi me, bhikkhave, amanāpā nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa mantaṃ vācetuṃ, kim'aṅga pana eta'r'ahi na amanāpā bhavissati nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ.

21750.grammar: ind, adv, interr, comp, acc sg of kimaṅga
21750.meaning1: how much more so?; how much rather?; what to say of?; why not?

examples.text: ime ce'pi, mahānāma, mahāsālā subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ime c'āhaṃ mahāsāle byākareyyaṃ, sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā'ti, kim'aṅgaṃ pana saraṇāniṃ sakkaṃ
tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āyasmā ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamī'ti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno evam'āha, ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhan'ti?

21751.meaning1: how except for?; what besides?; what apart (from)?

examples.text: yo hi, gahapati, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharanto muhuttam'pi ārogyaṃ paṭijāneyya, kim'aññatra bālyā?
yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

21752.meaning1: why teach another? why instruct another?

examples.text: sace maggaṃ anubuddhaṃ, khemaṃ amatagāminaṃ, apehi gaccha tvam'ev'eko, kim'aññam'anusāsasī'ti.

21753.meaning1: what should one desiring (one's own) benefit?

examples.text: kim'atthakāmo na dade, kiṃ macco na pariccaje, kiṃsu muñceyya kalyāṇaṃ, pāpikaṃ na ca mocaye'ti.

21754.grammar: ind, adv, interr, comp, acc sg of kimattha
21754.meaning1: why?; for what purpose?; what's the reason?; what's the meaning?
21754.commentary: (MNa) kim'atthaṃ carah'āvuso'ti yadi sīlavisuddhi-ādīnaṃ atthāya brahmacariyaṃ na vussati, atha kim'atthaṃ vussatī'ti pucchi. (JAa) kimatthan'ti kiṃkāraṇaṃ sampassamānā?

examples.text: kim'atthaṃ carah'āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? anupādāparinibbān'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.
kim'attham'abhisandhāya, lahucittassa dubbhino, sabbakāmadadass'eva, imaṃ dukkhaṃ titikkhasi.

21755.grammar: ind, interr, dat sg of kimattha, comp

21756.meaning1: what's the purpose of?; for what purpose?

examples.text: kim'atthiyaṃ nu kho, bho ānanda, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? chandappahān'atthaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rāhula, kim'atthiyo ādāso'ti? paccavekkhaṇ'attho, bhante'ti.

21757.meaningLit: discourse on for what purpose is the holy life

21762.meaning1: having what end?; culminating in what?

examples.text: imāni ca, bhikkhave, tīṇ'indriyāni kim'antāni? khay'antāni.

21763.meaning1: what's between? what's happening with?; (comm) what's the reason?

examples.text: nadītīresu saṇṭhāne, sabhāsu rathiyāsu ca, janā saṅgamma mantenti, mañ'ca tañ'ca kim'antaran'ti.
imassa pana te, māgaṇḍiya, kim'assa vacanīyan'ti? na kiñci, bho gotama.

assakhaḷuṅko hi, sandha, doṇiyā baddho, yavasaṃ yavasan'ti jhāyati. taṃ kissa hetu? na hi, sandha, assakhaḷuṅkassa doṇiyā baddhassa evaṃ hoti, kiṃ nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kim'ass'āhaṃ paṭikaromī'ti.
anumaty'atthe ca parikapp'atthe ca anuttakāle sattamīvibhatti hoti. tvaṃ gaccheyyāsi, kim'ahaṃ kareyyāmi.
te ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kim'āgamma kim'ārabbha pubb'antakappikā pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti aṭṭhārasahi vatthūhi?

21768.meaning1: with what purpose?; for what benefit?

examples.text: kim'atthiyāni, bhante, kusalāni sīlāni kim'ānisaṃsānī'ti? avippaṭisār'atthāni kho, ānanda, kusalāni sīlāni avippaṭisār'ānisaṃsānī'ti.

21769.meaning1: based on what?; owing to what?
21769.meaning2: based on what? owing to what?

examples.text: te ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kim'āgamma kim'ārabbha pubb'antakappikā pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti aṭṭhārasahi vatthūhi?
kim'ārammaṇā, samiddhi, purisassa saṅkappavitakkā uppajjantī'ti? nāmarūp'ārammaṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kva nānattaṃ gacchantī'ti? dhātūsu, bhante'ti.

21771.meaning1: what does he say; what is his opinion (about)

examples.text: santi, bhante, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā dvayena oghassa nittharaṇaṃ paññapenti, sīlavisuddhihetu ca tapojigucchāhetu ca. idha, bhante, bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

21772.meaning1: (what) nourishes what?; eats what?; feeds on what?

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya.

sabbapaṭhamaṃ tāva kiñci'd'eva karuṇāyitabbarūpaṃ… hatthapādehi paggharantakimigaṇaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karontaṃ disvā, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.

21774.meaning1: family of worms; species of maggot
21774.meaning2: crowd or a kind of worms

21776.meaning1: why is it? how is it that? what is up with this?
21776.commentary: (THIa) kim'idaṃ carasi momuhā'ti kiṃ nām'idaṃ, yaṃ pāsaṇḍavihitaṃ ujuṃ nibbānamaggaṃ pahāya ajja kālikaṃ kumaggaṃ paṭipajjantī ativiya mūḷhā carasi paribbhamasī'ti.

examples.text: kaṃ nu uddissa muṇḍ'āsi, samaṇī viya dissasi, na ca rocesi pāsaṇḍe, kim'idaṃ carasi momuhā.

21779.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; associate of Anuruddha
21779.commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena tāvatiṃse nibbattitvā apar'āparaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde kapilavatthunagare sākiyarājakule nibbatti, kimilo'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. so vayappatto bhogasampattiyā sampanno viharati. tassa ñāṇaparipākaṃ disvā saṃvegajanan'atthaṃ anupiyāyaṃ viharanto satthā paṭhamayobbane ṭhitaṃ dassanīyaṃ itthirūpaṃ abhinimminitvā purato dassetvā puna anukkamena yathā jarārogavipattīhi abhibhūtā dissati, tathā akāsi.
21779.notes: Theragāthā verse 118 (TH1.118, TH118) is attributed to him.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimilāyaṃ viharati niculavane. atha kho āyasmā kimilo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

21788.meaning2: having what as its chief characteristic? having what as most excellent?

examples.text: kim'etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo āha puna bhavaṃ gotamo bravitū'ti

ehi tvaṃ, āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi, therā taṃ, āvuso khemaka, evam'āhaṃsu, yam'etaṃ, āvuso khemaka, asmī'ti vadesi, kim'etaṃ asmī'ti vadesi?

21790.meaning1: what is this?; what about this?

examples.text: tam'enaṃ sāmikā ahikuṇapaṃ vā kukkurakuṇapaṃ vā manussakuṇapaṃ vā racayitvā aññissā kaṃsapātiyā paṭikujjitvā antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ. tam'enaṃ jano disvā evaṃ vadeyya, ambho, kim'ev'idaṃ harīyati jaññajaññaṃ viyā'ti?
disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.
